title: suregada microcarpa
intro: Suregada microcarpa, commonly known as the 'Malabar ironwood' or 'Malabar boxwood', is a medicinal plant belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Suregada microcarpa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which help in reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
